text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Curren, what kind of fan service do you
do during
winning concerts?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, I don't really have a set routine.
Maybe I
should come up with one.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then let's make one right now! I'll even
give you
some professional advice! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow, really? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll start off with what I
normally do.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me and ooonly me!
Okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's all I've got... I bet it's a little
boring,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
N-no... it's perfect just the way it is!
Everything
from your tone to your pose
was flawless! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aw, thank you! I'm glad I got your seal
of
approval. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That was her normal routine? Curren...
Just who
are you?!
